method: Unique visitors who sent the analytics event "human" since 14 Nov 00:00 UTC. A browser sends it once, ever, after 5 s visible plus a touch/scroll/click/key; automated browsers (navigator.webdriver) never send it. Source: analytics.agentfirststack.com. Code: /js/human.js. Honest limit: this counts browsers that behaved like a person, not proven distinct people (one person on two devices counts twice). by_* and by_hour_utc are published so that any burst from one source is visible.
